teaching.example: The kitten sleeps in my bag.

extra_examples.en: Our kitten plays with a ball.

teaching.student_prompt: 轻轻学一声猫叫，再说 a little kitten。
teaching.note: 原创 KET 课堂例句；先读单词与例句，再学习构词或常用搭配。

word_study.explanation_zh: kitten 是“幼猫”，整体记，不硬拆。复数 kittens 只加 -s；pet kitten 是“宠物小猫”。

family.connection_zh: pet 说明小猫是家里养的宠物。

example.en: My pet kitten is very small.

challenge.prompt_zh: 两只小猫里的“小猫”怎么拼？

images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: one classroom vocabulary photograph for Chinese primary-school KET learners; landscape 3:2, ideally 1536x1024.
Style: beautiful playful realistic editorial photography, bright natural daylight, rich plausible colours, real materials and textures, correct anatomy, uncluttered composition, clear main subject for a large projector.
Constraints: no embedded text, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, decorative frames, cartoons or clipart. All people fictional, children fully clothed in ordinary appropriate clothes. Generous margins, no clipped main subject, safe friendly scenes.
Primary request: A tiny realistic ginger kitten with white chin, white paws and amber eyes asleep comfortably in a fully open teal cloth backpack on a low indoor bench. The kitten is the dominant main subject, curled up peacefully with clear soft fur, little paws and natural ears, natural warm daylight, bag opening wide and safe, no closed zipper. Charming intimate pet photograph, no costumes or humanisation.
